Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess, os, itertools, string
cands=[]
base=b'#! /usr/bin/'
for n in range(1,40):
    for s in [base[:n], b'#! /usr/bin/python'[:n], b'#! /usr/local/bin/python'[:n], b'#! /usr/bin/env python'[:n]]:
        if s and s not in cands: cands.append(s)
for s in cands:
    open('/tmp/testpoc','wb').write(s)
    p=subprocess.run(['/tmp/magic_driver','/tmp/testpoc'],env={**os.environ,'ASAN_OPTIONS':'detect_leaks=0'},capture_output=True,text=True)
    out=p.stderr+p.stdout
    if 'READ of size 13' in out:
        print('FOUND',len(s),repr(s))
        print('\n'.join(out.splitlines()[:8]))
        raise SystemExit
print('none')
PY
